title: Code, results and protocol for 'What Own Feedback Costs Online Conformal Value-at-Risk: Per-Shock Lower Bounds, Known-Law Attainment and the Exact First Day'
description: Simulation and analysis code, JSON results, the supplement (full proofs and results) and the frozen, hashed confirmatory protocol with two amendments for the paper. The empirical study is exploratory; the confirmatory test has not been run. Raw vendor data are not redistributed; download scripts and SHA-256 checksums are included.
